audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer swaps Naafiri's kit: her engage is called 'W The Hunt' (fabricated name — the lock-on pack dash is R Hounds' Pursuit) and her R is called 'Call of the Pack' described as a non-defensive skirmish tool (Call of the Pack is her W, an untargetability + pack empower; her actual R's recast grants a shield, so it IS defensive). 'R healing' also wrong — the pack heal is E Eviscerate.
audit.why: Kit file authority: W = The Call of the Pack (untargetable, 26-18s CD), E = Eviscerate (dash + packmate heal), R = Hounds' Pursuit (900-range pack dash, 110/95/80s, recast shield).
audit.corrected: All names and roles corrected; untargetable-W and R-shield missing interactions folded into cooldowns and spike text.

edits.before: R Supreme Display of Talent swings it to you: your single-target burst combo kills her outright before her dogs stack meaningful damage. Dodge her W The Hunt engage with E Audacity or a W dash, then E-Q-R her once the pack is committed. Her R Call of the Pack is a skirmish/objective tool, not a defensive save, so it won't stop a clean all-in.
edits.after: R Supreme Display of Talent swings it to you: your single-target burst combo kills her outright before her dogs stack meaningful damage. Sidestep her R Hounds' Pursuit engage with your own W dash, and respect W Call of the Pack — she goes untargetable, so hold your combo rather than burn it into thin air — then E-Q-R once both are spent.

edits.before: With your first item you win the all-in cleanly. She has no hard escape, so the moment she uses W The Hunt to engage and it's on cooldown, punish with your full combo. Track her Q daggers on the ground; killing her before the packmates re-path removes most of her damage.
edits.after: With your first item you win the all-in cleanly. She has no hard escape, so the moment she commits R Hounds' Pursuit and it's on cooldown, punish with your full combo. Track her Q daggers on the ground; killing her before the packmates re-path removes most of her damage.

edits.before: Two items keep you ahead because you assassinate her from fog before her pack ramps, and Qiyana's burst outpaces Naafiri's sustained dog damage in a flank.
